name: mirage
text: v1.0.21 is released: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.21 . It stops the Boston pile-up: at most 3 filled live tail buys per game, and no buying a side again once its price is 3+ points under what you already paid. v1.0.22 (Kalshi slip hides the bet, Kalshi bids round to 1 contract, Kalshi list read from GitHub) is building; I'll post its link when it lands.
